title: Prefix count under pointwise agreement
statement: Let $kf,kf':\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and let $s,m\in\mathbb{N}$. If $kf(i)=kf'(i)$ for every $i<m$, then the numbers of indices below $m$ at which these functions, respectively, are less than $s$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $kf,kf'$ are functions from natural numbers to natural numbers.
The functions agree at every index $i<m$.
